title: Streaming and state ownership
summary: Stateful processing is first-class. Semantic sessions own block sequence, EOS, flush, checkpoint identity and state version while providers own numerical state such as FFT history, learned noise floors and IIR state.
invariants: Stateful providers do not require callers to fake overlap when history is provider-owned.
Checkpoints are detached value evidence and never serialize live Python/native/tensor state.
State modes distinguish NONE, CHECKPOINTABLE and PROVIDER_AFFINE.
Provider-affine streams require session affinity when dispatched.
